# spa commands

Generated from `spa agent schema`. Do not edit this file; regenerate with
`spa --no-agent agent schema --markdown`. Workflows stay in the [user guide](user-guide.md).

Playbooks are not listed here. Discover them with `spa --json run --list`
and `spa run NAME --help`.

## `init`

Scaffold or migrate an env dir (spa init --example TOPOLOGY --provider aws|virtualbox ENV)

## `features`

Choose from concise topology/provider/setting records; use show ID --keys only for per-key types and constraints

Example:

```bash
spa --json features show setting.ssl --keys
```

## `validate`

Validate splunk_config.yml (schema, Software/baseconfig/local apps, inventory)

## `doctor`

Host prerequisite checks

## `env`

Print export statements for direnv

## `provision`

Provision infrastructure using the provider selected by splunk_config.yml

Requires confirmation: yes (`--yes`).

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-y`, `--yes` | Confirm provision |

Example:

```bash
spa provision --yes && spa deploy --yes
```

## `deploy`

Deploy Splunk (deploy_site.yml); requires Software/baseconfig and local app sources

Requires confirmation: yes (`--yes`).

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-y`, `--yes` | Confirm deploy (required in agent mode) |
| `--hosts` | only these hosts (names or roles from this env) |
| `--allow-unprovisioned` | Skip the check that every config host is in inventory |

## `destroy`

Destroy infrastructure using the configured provider

Requires confirmation: yes (`--yes`).

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-y`, `--yes` | Confirm destroy |

## `suspend`

Stop managed instances without destroying disks or provider state

Requires confirmation: yes (`--yes`).

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-y`, `--yes` | Confirm power change |
| `--no-wait` | Return after requesting stop |
| `--hosts` | only these hosts (names or roles from this env) |

## `resume`

Start managed instances and refresh inventory if needed

Requires confirmation: yes (`--yes`).

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-y`, `--yes` | Confirm power change |
| `--hosts` | only these hosts (names or roles from this env) |

## `hosts list`

List inventory hosts and roles

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--status` | Include runtime power state and connectivity |
| `--hosts` | only these hosts (names or roles from this env) |

Example:

```bash
spa hosts list --status
```

## `hosts ssh`

SSH using inventory

Example:

```bash
spa hosts ssh idx1
```

## `hosts copy`

Copy files with scp: SRC DST, remote side HOST:PATH (-r for directories)

Example:

```bash
spa hosts copy local.txt idx1:/tmp/
```

## `shell`

Alias of spa hosts ssh

## `aws`

AWS discovery for terraform.aws

## `licenses`

Inspect license type, expiration and ITSI/ES entitlements

## `run`

Run a playbook by stem. Discover: spa --json run --list then spa run NAME --help. Honor data[].requires_confirmation with --yes.

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--hosts` | only these hosts (names or roles from this env) |
| `--list` | Catalog playbooks with summaries |
| `-y`, `--yes` | Confirm a mutating playbook (required in agent mode) |
| `--apps-playbook` | For splunk_apps_playbook_run: curated stem or env-relative path (sets apps_playbook and app_name) |

Example:

```bash
spa run --list
```

## `apps search`

Search Splunkbase (compact rows: app_id, name, title, type, kind, version, summary)

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--limit` | Max hits (default 10) |
| `--type` | Filter Splunkbase type (app, addon) |
| `--kind` | Filter SPA kind (ta, premium_itsi, itsi_content_library, itsi_content_pack_single, es_not_premium) |

Example:

```bash
spa --json apps search unix
```

## `apps snippet`

Print apps[] YAML for a Splunkbase app_id or local custom app folder

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--version` | Release version (default latest) |
| `--roles` | Comma-separated target_roles (TA only) |
| `--source` | Snippet source: splunkbase or local; local checks apps_dir |
| `--local` | Shorthand for --source local |
| `--customize` | Include matching curated apps_playbooks customizations in the YAML |

Example:

```bash
spa --json apps snippet 833
```

## `apps download`

Download a Splunkbase archive into apps_dir (does not edit config or print a snippet)

Requires confirmation: yes (`--yes`).

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-y`, `--yes` | Confirm download (required in agent mode) |
| `--version` | Release version (default latest) |
| `--extract` | Safely extract a folder-backed app into apps_dir and delete the archive (TA/ES only) |
| `--overwrite` | With --extract, replace an existing app folder in apps_dir |

Example:

```bash
spa apps download 833 --yes
```

## `agent schema`

| Flag | Description |

```bash
spa --no-agent agent schema --markdown
```
